summary: __thiscall getter: returns whether bit a2 of the byte field at this[110] (offset 0x6E) is set. Computes (1 << a2) truncated to unsigned byte, ANDs it with this[110], and returns nonzero when the bit is set. No side effects.

operations.description: Build the single-bit mask 1 << a2 truncated to an unsigned byte.
AND the mask with the byte at this[110] (offset 0x6E) and test for nonzero.
Return the boolean result of the bit test.

Called by SessionConfigWriteback (0x00461900), DriverEntrantSetupEntry (0x00462550), MultiplayerPasswordValidation (0x0046DD30) and sub_475150 (0x00475150) to test an individual flag bit on an unknown owner object.

unresolved: Semantic meaning of the bit flags stored at this[110] (offset 0x6E) and of the bit index a2 is unknown; each caller decides what flag it is asking about.
Identity and purpose of the owner object are unknown.
